Name: AI NPCs talk like co-op friends in group chat
Description:
简介
星谷群聊——让 AI 村民用联机好友聊天框跟你群聊，就像真人朋友在线打字一样。告别传统 NPC 对话框，34 位村民以好友身份陪你种地，从此不再孤单。
安装方法
下载并解压。将整个 
[code]NPC-talking[/code] 文件夹放入 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]，启动游戏即可，SMAPI 会自动加载。
主要功能
[list]
[*][b]好友聊天形式[/b] — NPC 使用联机聊天框而非传统对话框，按回车随时随地开聊。[/*]
[*][b]主动触发群聊[/b] — 购物、烹饪、收获、送礼等 18 种事件自动引发 NPC 发起群聊。[/*]
[*][b]每周来信送礼[/b] — 每周日收到总结你一周活动的信件和礼物，节日也会来信。[/*]
[*][b]双语支持[/b] — 自动适配游戏语言（中文或英文）。[/*]
[/list]前置要求
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6[/*]
[*]一个 DeepSeek API Key（在 platform.deepseek.com 注册充值，创建 Key 后填入 
[code]config.json[/code]）[/*]
[*]Description
Stardew Chatter lets AI villagers chat with you through the multiplayer-style messaging UI — the same chat box real co-op friends use. Instead of scripted NPC dialogue boxes, 34 villagers message you like actual online friends. Never farm alone again.
Installation Instructions
Download and extract the mod. Place the entire 
[code]NPC-talking[/code] folder into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] folder. Launch the game — SMAPI will load it automatically.
Main Features
[list]
[*][b]Chat like real friends[/b] — NPCs use the multiplayer chat UI, not the standard dialogue box. Press Enter anytime, anywhere.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-triggered chats[/b] — NPCs start conversations on their own when you shop, cook, harvest, give gifts, and more (18 events total).[/*]
[*][b]Spouse grocery runs[/b] — Your spouse shops and cooks for you on weekends.[/*]
[*][b]Bilingual[/b] — Automatically matches your game language (English or Chinese).[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]A DeepSeek API Key (register at platform.deepseek.com, top up, create a key, and paste it into 
[code]config.json[/code])[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
